title: Operator-owned release boundary
summary: Release MUST coordinate allocation, version metadata, integration, reconciliation, and local landing from already verified incoming data. Remote actions remain operator-owned.
instructions: The ship stage and release commands MUST NOT run tests, inspect, collect, or check evidence, review artifact diagnostics, validate release artifacts, or gate on validation.

Workflow ship MUST carry forward the incoming data.verify.evidence_packet reference and the verifier's supplied release disclosures without checking their evidence. It MUST NOT collect a separate evidence bundle. Standalone /pan-release MUST work without workflow verification records or invented stage proofs.

A failed verify MUST follow its declared failure transition. The verifier owns any renewed product verification after source changes during integration or reconciliation. Release MUST NOT run or adjudicate that verification.

The release steward MUST construct release notes and choose the bump from the declared release delta. pan release land MUST coordinate integration, reconciliation, allocation, metadata construction, release and index commits, and local landing. The landing mutex and allocation authority MUST serialize shared release resources.

The release packet MUST carry forward the supplied verification outcome, active operator gate waivers, deferred acceptance criteria, reviewer criterion amendments, and linked spotfix cases. It MUST NOT describe a waived gate or an amended criterion as an ordinary pass.
The release packet MUST include the supplied rollback guidance, unresolved non-blocking risks, and a concise change summary.
For Pancreator self-development only, the release steward MUST update release metadata under VERSION-001 before operator approval. Embedded target workflows MUST remain release-metadata read-only.

Self-development ship with a managed worktree MUST checkpoint eligible changes. It MUST let pan release land update metadata and create the release and index commits once. A retry MUST preserve an already completed release and index pair.

The workflow MUST pause for operator approval before branch push, pull-request creation, remote merge, publication, or deployment. Local landing through pan release land remains part of release coordination.
When away mode allows `approve`, the supervisor MAY approve a successful ship packet with `pan away decide`.
That approval MUST apply only the recorded outcome and the terminal workflow transition.
An away-mode ship approval MUST NOT authorize push, pull-request creation, remote merge, publication, deployment, or branch deletion.
